limits.source: OS00_リファレンスマニュアル_rev1.1.pdf
limits.scope: Published width/cut-specific limits; no lifetime/temperature derating supplied. Linear metal-width scaling is an engineering interpretation.

em_check.scope: DC power-network envelope only, linear width scaling; conservative M1 step rating used on all M1. No contact/signal/internal-cell or transient EM qualification; not sign-off.

rows.comparison_scope: Exact same GDS-extracted devices and terminal orientation: device-only (pre-wire) versus device+estimated wire C. Original GateNetlist schematic remains the independent LVS reference in schematic.spice.
rows.static_scope: maximum/mean over documented unique representative states; N=1 includes all 27
rows.scope: Estimated substrate C only: SiO2 epsilon_r=3.9, effective M1/M2 heights 1/2 um, fringe=0.02 fF/um perimeter. Assumed, not PDK calibrated. Reviewed OS00 rev1.1 p5 (no parasitic extraction), OS04 p7 and model libraries; the ESD M1-M2 overlap rule is not a metal-to-substrate coefficient. No coupling, shielding, via C or signal wire R; not signoff PEX. Constant nominal-bias cell currents; centerline sheet-R network. Default metal sheet R=0.05 ohm/square and via R=0.05 ohm are assumed, not PDK characterized; no package R, self-heating or voltage-dependent current iteration. OS00 p9 resistor sheet values do not apply to metal; no metal/TC/contact resistance found in the open PDFs/models. Zero shift assumes equal divider conductances.

comparison_scope: Identical GDS-extracted intrinsic devices: device-only (pre-wire) versus devices plus estimated wire C. Legacy source-schematic delays archived in results/phase4_before_matched/.
measurement: 1 ns ramps; settling from ramp start to final entry into ±0.5 V, through entire segment; 2 ns default max timestep
coverage: four directed full-length carry assertion/release transitions, both polarities; overflow/zero/opposite/alternating; N=1 additionally all 27 states
limits: Nominal models only. Static power covers documented states. Resistive-divider cells draw DC current even without switching. IR envelope is separate from ideal-rail SPICE. Wire C and metal R remain assumptions where the open PDK supplies no value. PDK current limits are width/cut-specific; linear width scaling is not EM sign-off. Routing heuristics/seed can change die area.

fits.method: ordinary least squares, free intercept, all passing measured widths
fits.scope: Nominal deterministic samples, not PVT confidence bounds or unmeasured-width predictions. Power per cell is an effective average for this adder mix and documented-state maximum. Resistive dividers draw DC at idle; frequency reduction alone does not remove that current.
